description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Riven''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] in the target direction, though not through terrain, while granting herself a [[File:Hybrid resistances icon.png|20px|link=Shield|An icon representing the keyword Shield]] [[:Shield|shield]] for 1.5 seconds.
description.text: Active: Riven dashes in the target direction, though not through terrain, while granting herself a shield for 1.5 seconds.

description2.raw: '''''Riven''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash. Valor will cast at max range if cast beyond that.''
description2.text: Riven can cast any of her abilities during the dash. Valor will cast at max range if cast beyond that.

leveling.raw:
'''Shield Strength:'''
70 / 95 / 120 / 145 / 170 (+ 110% '''bonus''' AD)

notes.raw: * This ability always employs [[Quick cast]]. * [[File:Riven Broken Wings.png|20xpx|border|link=Riven#Broken Wings|An icon for Riven's ability Broken Wings]] [[Riven#Broken Wings|Broken Wings]] may be cast during [[File:Riven Ki Burst.png|20xpx|border|link=Riven#Ki Burst|An icon for Riven's ability Ki Burst]] [[Riven#Ki Burst|Ki Burst]] or [[File:Riven Blade of the Exile.png|20xpx|border|link=Riven#Blade of the Exile|An icon for Riven's ability Blade of the Exile]] [[Riven#Blade of the Exile|Blade of the Exile]] cast times if they're used at the end or briefly after the dash.(bug)
notes.text:
This ability always employs Quick cast.
Broken Wings may be cast during Ki Burst or Blade of the Exile cast times if they're used at the end or briefly after the dash.(bug)
